auth_details: No API key required for standard programmatic access; requests are identified by IP and subject to usage policies.
free_tier_limits: Free public service; subject to rate and volume policies (no paid plans)
description: PubChem is NCBI's free chemical information system. Its REST (PUG-REST) and related programmatic interfaces return compound structures, properties, synonyms, and bioassay data for chemistry and cheminformatics applications.
resolution_notes: Audited against live official sources on 2026-08-08. rate_limits: auditor correct — PubChem PUG-REST docs specify no more than 5 requests per second; excessive traffic may be throttled with 503. example.response_snippet: auditor correct — live PUG-REST JSON returns MolecularWeight as a string ("180.16"), not a number. Evidence: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/docs/programmatic-access and live GET https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/aspirin/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight/JSON
